scenarios: list, call and cancel against a real MCP server process with the cancellation on the wire and the audit correlation through the server's own record
a hostile server's declaration refused item by item while its good tools stand
the kernel binds an undeclared tool's call to an approval and only then does the effect reach the server
two sessions share one server process while a changed configuration and a changed workspace each get their own
an interrupted effectful call is an unknown outcome
the admin/project/user layers resolve deterministically with provenance and a lease decides which servers a task may reach
a proposal is inert until a person trusts it and the credential gate is met
a returned credential is redacted before the answer leaves the host
an image result reaches a vision-capable model as the egress copy
a protected browser action prefers the site's structured tool when trust allows and the interface is the fallback otherwise
proof: the real modbit-core binary against real MCP server processes over real pipes, including a hostile one; the servers' own logs are read back to correlate what they were asked with what the Core logged.
audit: ABSENT before M9.4: docs/17 listed the hub's surface as unbuilt, the resolved configuration carried mcp_servers nobody read, and DR-M5-001 and DR-M7-001 had deferred two tasks for want of this gateway.
limitations: stdio transport only; bounded pagination and no list_changed; an agent proposes through a person's client; no idle eviction in the pool; audio normalized but unroutable.
ci: main CI green on macOS, Linux and Windows (runs 35360592014, 35371697634, 35391720594)
